verdict.rationale: vLLM is open-source, self-installed software that serves models in open Hugging Face formats (safetensors-style checkpoints, GGUF and other quantization formats) and exposes an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API, so lock-in is low and leaving is easy. However, the evidence never addresses exporting user data, likely because vLLM is a stateless engine that holds none. Missing for 10: any documented data-export or portability mechanism, explicit confirmation that no user data is retained, independent corroboration of migrating off vLLM.
